Team —

Attached is the working OKR compact for the Q2 launch window (OKR_compact_v1.xlsx). This is the condensed owners' view I want us to sign off on for the executive QBR packet.

Key asks:
- Owners: please review objectives + success metrics and confirm or propose alternative baselines by Tue Apr 6 EOD.
- Highlight any unmitigated risks or resource gaps inline (I flagged three in the doc).
- If you cannot sign by Apr 6, note the blocker and an expected resolution date.

Notes about the doc:
- Column H has the measurement cadence and current baseline; I pulled these from our last telemetry run and Sasha's sprint reports.
- I included a short risk column; please add mitigations or owners for each risk.

Link to working folder (edit access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-okrs-q2

Attachments: OKR_compact_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll pull these comments into a consolidated owner_commit_matrix and circulate an updated compact before the QBR dry run.

Thanks — Sergio

Sergio —

Thanks for the compact. Quick feedback inline and attached a small capacity estimate for the launch engineering work (capacity_estimates.pdf).

- Objective 1 wording: suggest "Reduce inference p99 latency by 15% for hosted API" -> "Bring p99 latency for hosted API to <= X ms on standard bundle" (we should call out the standard bundle explicitly).
- Baselines: some baselines in column H are older (Mar 2027). I've noted a couple places where we should pull the Apr 1 telemetry before we finalize.
- Risk #2 (third-party infra burst): I recommend adding a 2-week procurement contingency in the mitigation.

I'll update my owner-level acceptance in the drive once I confirm the Apr 1 numbers.

Laura

Two items from infra/serving side:

1) Metric baselines: the doc lists a p95 baseline but team's primary SLO is p99; can we align metric column to p99 across Objectives 1 & 2? I'll drop a short note in the spreadsheet where I think we should normalize.
2) Canary playbook: for Objective 3 (traffic routing & fallbacks), we should attach the minimal canary runbook. I'll copy a trimmed version into the drive; this will affect the timeline/risk column.

If folks are comfortable with p99 baselines and the canary plan, we'll be able to sign off from infra. I expect to have the playbook note in the folder by EOD today.
